incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high error rate for auth-service/token-verify in us-west-2 -> alert fired (avg 6.8% 5xx over 5m)
pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to alex (oncall) — priority P1 — escalation policy: auth-sre
alex (oncall): acked — I'm on it, pulling logs now
sam (sre): joining, pinging JWKS/cert endpoints for verification failures
rachel (eng): quick heads up — we pushed a small key-roll job to staging earlier today but not prod. could be related.
alex (oncall): seeing a lot of token-verify rejects with "kid not found" in verifier logs
alex (oncall): sample log:
```
ERROR auth.verify: token validation failed: public key KID=9a2b not found in jwks (expected 9a2b)
request_id=req-0a1b2c user_id=... path=/v1/generate
```
sam (sre): running curl against jwks endpoints:
```
curl -s https://auth-reissues.us-west-2.redwood.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"0f1c"
"1d2e"
"2a3b"
```
sam (sre): verifier config expects KID 9a2b — mismatch. it looks like the signing pipeline pushed a new set but didn't include the old fallback key.
rachel (eng): ack — I deployed the key-rotation job to canary but job failed to include legacy KID; pipeline had a bug in merge logic. rolling back canary now.
casey (cs): are customers impacted? any paying customers seeing auth failures?
alex (oncall): SDK/HTTP clients show ~2% request failures from internal health checks + elevated 5xx on API gateway for token verify routes. CS: one enterprise tenant reported login issues via support ticket 78912.
mike (devops): suggest immediate mitigation: temporarily accept multiple KIDs by adding legacy key into verifier cache from last-known-store, or fallback to signing-service secondary endpoint.
rachel (eng): coordinates — I can push a hotfix to verifier that reads backup-jwks file from s3 and loads missing KIDs. small patch, no restart needed for runtime that supports dynamic JWKS. preparing PR now.
sam (sre): if hotfix is >5m, we should flip gateway rule to bypass token verification for non-admin internal endpoints only — reduce blast radius. need approval from security.
alex (oncall): I will notify security and exec on-call. tagging @security on Slack.
alex (oncall): pagerduty-bot: acknowledge and annotate — mitigation path: hotfix to verifier + backfill JWKS from s3. ETA 12-15m.
casey (cs): posting proactive message to affected customer + status page note: "Investigating authentication errors in us-west-2; engineers are mitigating."
rachel (eng): PR created: hotfix loads /etc/auth/backup_jwks.json on missing kid -> will push to prod canary first. patch link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4212
sam (sre): applying canary now -> monitor token-verify errors and gateway 5xx
alex (oncall): canary results (5m): token-verify error rate dropped from 6.8% -> 1.1% in canary cluster, no regressions observed.
alex (oncall): rolling patch to prod in batches, will watch error rate and latency.
mike (devops): also re-adding legacy KID to central jwks store from backup (s3://redwood-jwks/last_good/2026-03-15.json)
rachel (eng): legacy KID re-added and signed key propagated to jwks cache in <2m
sam (sre): global error rate now 0.9% and trending down; gateway 5xx back to baseline
pagerduty-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated — monitoring
alex (oncall): handing off to sam for post-incident monitoring and RCA writeup. Sam, you're on-call for the next 30m.
sam (sre): taking over, will run postmortem checklist and capture timeline. initial root cause: key-rotation job in staging had merge logic bug that dropped legacy KID; deployment pipeline mistakenly allowed that to apply to prod jwks store.
casey (cs): I updated the customer with a message and will follow up with details once RCA done.
alex (oncall): final notes: total customer-impact window ~22m, mitigated without requiring global service restart. filing incident ticket and RCA.
sam (sre): noted. I'll include follow-ups: add automated verification that new jwks contains expected KIDs, add rollback guard in deployment pipeline, and add synthetic token-verification test post-deploy.
casey (cs): thanks team :white_check_mark: — CS will run through impacted customer list and escalate any contract-level issues.
incident-bot: Incident closed (monitoring) — summary will be created in incidents/3032109876 oncall-log
